what: B (fresh device; 1.3.0 is the newest it ships): Worlds → World files → Choose a .world file (answers $SCR/files/b2-import.world, a copy of A's 1.2.0 export); read the report; name Bo; Bring it in; Play opens

actions.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const t = document.body.innerText; if (/problem/.test(t) || /Every check passed/.test(t) || /Error/.test(t)) break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const t = document.body.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('Import a .world'); return t.slice(at, at + 1500) })()

(() => { const f = [...document.querySelectorAll('input')].find(x => (x.closest('label')?.innerText ?? '').includes('Your name in this world')); if (!f) return 'no name field'; f.focus(); f.select(); return f.value })()

(async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 160; i++) { const s = S.useSessionStore.getState(); if (s.screen === 'play' && s.activeInstance) return { ms: Math.round(performance.now() - window.__t0), screen: s.screen }; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const t = document.body.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('Import a .world'); return 'timeout: ' + t.slice(at, at + 1500) })()

(async () => { const H = await import('/history/index.ts'); const n = H.worldNow(); return JSON.stringify({ world: n?.world, head: n?.head, cartridge: n?.genesis?.body?.cartridge ?? null, physics: n?.genesis?.body?.physicsVersion ?? null, genesisAuthor: n?.genesis?.author ?? null, owners: Object.keys(n?.owners ?? {}), chunks: n && Object.keys(n.chunks), sequencer: n?.sequencer ?? null }) })()
